description.en: A third person camera that keeps other mods working.
Camera, aim, view distance, sky and enemy indicators. Keeps working in any lobby.
Every weapon reaches as far as the farthest one. Off in lobbies with players who don't run it.
Enemies notice and chase the squad from much farther away. Off in lobbies with players who don't run it.
In third person, the Helldiver can leave the shared top-down screen. Off in lobbies with players who don't run it.
Grenades and stratagem balls fly twice as far. Off in lobbies with players who don't run it.
The camera at the start of the game. Default is the top-down camera of the game. The camera key switches between the two in a mission.
How fast the camera turns with the mouse or the right stick.
Moving the mouse up looks down.
How much explosions, impacts and the Hellpod landing shake the shoulder camera.

When the Helldiver drops in, the camera rides down above the Hellpod looking down on it, shakes on the landing, and glides into the shoulder view once the Helldiver climbs out. The view stays still until then.

When the Helldiver dies, the camera stays on the body, or where the body was once the game removes it, until the Helldiver drops in again or the mission ends. With allies alive, the camera moves to one of them after 4 seconds. Left and right click switch between allies, and the mouse turns the camera.
Once the Helldiver boards the shuttle, the camera rides with the shuttle as it takes off and flies away, until the mission ends. The mouse turns the camera.

The side of the Helldiver the camera sits on. The swap key, or a tap of the right stick on a gamepad, changes it in a mission. A mech camera starts on the same side; in any vehicle the swap key moves the camera from left to the middle to right.
Meters between the camera and the Helldiver on foot in a mission.
Vertical field of view on foot in third person.
Raises or lowers the third-person camera on foot, in a dive, while down, in vehicles and on the Super Destroyer.
Meters between the camera and the Helldiver on the Super Destroyer.
Brings the camera down during a dive, quickly but smoothly, and eases it back up once the dive ends.
While the Helldiver is down and crawling, the camera sits as low as in a dive, and 1 m farther back.
Meters between the camera and the vehicle: mech, APC, bike and turrets. A mech camera sits beside the shoulder, other vehicles in the middle and high.
Vertical field of view in a vehicle.

A ring around the crosshair in four segments. The right, back and left segments show faintly while an enemy is in range on that side, and stronger within half the range. The side with the closest enemy within half the range also shows a warning triangle. Hidden while the game is paused.
Enemies closer than this show on the ring; within half of it, the segment is stronger.

A bar near the crosshair points toward where a hit came from and fades within 2 seconds: red when health is lost, yellow when the personal shield takes it, white when the vehicle does. A bar for an enemy follows the enemy.
In third person, stratagem beacons and objectives out of view show at the edge of the screen, with the icons and colours of the map.
In third person, while a grenade or a stratagem ball is held, a dashed line shows the way it would fly if thrown now, and a ring where it first lands.
In third person, the name cards of players show above their heads instead of at their feet.
Removes the fog of the level, in third person and in the top-down view. Photo Mode shows the fog while it is open.

Game default keeps the blur of the planet. Focus on the Helldiver keeps the Helldiver sharp and blurs what lies a metre or more nearer or farther. Off keeps the whole picture sharp. Photo Mode sets the depth of field while open.
Pushes the fog, the far edge of the view and the detail of distant models out, so distant enemies and landmarks show.

Draws a sky over the level for the time of the mission, dawn, day, dusk or night, instead of the smears the game leaves past the level: brighter toward the horizon, with the sun where the light of the level comes from, clouds, and stars and a moon at night. Needs a deploy.
Every weapon reaches as far as the farthest one, so targets far off in the third-person view can be hit. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.
Enemies notice and chase the squad from much farther away. Alarm range stays as in the game. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.
In third person, the Helldiver is no longer held on the shared top-down screen with the squad. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.
Grenades and stratagem balls fly twice as far, on top of the Strong Arm perk. Changes the shared game: off in lobbies with players who don't run it.

label.en: Switch the camera: top-down or third person
Swap the camera shoulder (in a vehicle: left, middle, right)
